description: The catalog of looks: the components that a view.json can name with "as". Each look has one Razor component in src/Orchestrator.Web/Components/Ui/Looks/<Name>Look.razor and one function in the LOOKS object of docs/render-design/page.html. A test checks both.

looks.name: code
looks.description: Monospace text: a path, a branch, a code snippet.

looks.name: well
looks.description: Text in a colored box: the main point of the document.

looks.name: list
looks.description: A bulleted list. "tone" colors the block.

looks.name: chips
looks.description: One chip for each item. "mark" names a field whose value gets the default mark.

looks.name: links
looks.description: A list of links. A value that is not an http URL shows as code.

looks.name: pill
looks.description: A small colored label. "tones" gives the color of each value.
